explanation: Single body with e=1 bouncing on floor with gravity 9.81. With large dt=0.0253 semi-implicit Euler introduces systematic energy gain on eachBounce/ flight; over 997 steps (25s) total mechanical energy drifts from 835.8 to 924.59 exceeding allowed 924.42 (E0*1.1+5). Halving dt to 0.01268 eliminates violation, confirming numerical dissipation/drift is dt-dependent, not controller work (which is zero).
